desc: Ideation: choose product-major bitset DP with separate zero-product DP.
Implement the full product-major bitset DP solution in the starter code, including positive-product DP with explicit non-empty start transitions, zero-product DP, and final descending scan.
Run provided examples and a brute-force checker on random tiny inputs plus edge cases (zeros, ones, k=0, limit=1, products exceeding limit), and report any failing cases.
